messages:
marie_cs: Omar from RallyPoint asked to run a pre-go-live burst rehearsal tonight. They want a short <10m high spike to validate autoscale and failover. Can we coordinate quotas and cost approval? @eng_leo @sre_nina
eng_leo: need expected burst qps, avg tokens, and whether they hit embeddings endpoints too.
customer_ops_omar: baseline 80 qps, planned 5m spike to 700 qps, avg tokens 180, embedding calls ~10% of traffic.
sre_nina: current max_instances=4; recommend temp max=10, target=6 during spike. I'll pre-warm KV cache for top 30 prefixes and wire fallback to quant-small. Set alert: p95>220ms or 5xx>2% -> rollback.
finance_maya: OK to cover up to 6 hours of extra GPU time if you send estimate. Prefer to consume burst credits first.
eng_leo: I'll run the k6 job and push artifacts to /tmp/rallypoint-rehearsal/1799004000. Script uses staged ramp then short spike.
marie_cs: deliverables post-run: P95, error rate, token cost delta, embedding latency breakdown, and recommendations for client-side rate limits. Schedule 20m post-run review.
deploy-bot: action scheduled: increase-pool temporary -> 1799004100 :rocket:
marie_cs: checklist ok? finance estimate in 10m, autoscale set, KV primed, k6 smoke passed, alerts wired. Anything else?
customer_ops_omar: please include a 1-pager for our ops on retry/backoff and embedding retries. Thanks! :thumbsup:
